title: Le Petit Chaperon Rouge - Partie 1
description: Un conte de fées classique raconté en français.

sentences.french: Il était une fois une petite fille qui vivait dans une forêt.
sentences.english: Once upon a time there was a little girl who lived in a forest.

sentences.french: Tout le monde l'appelait le Petit Chaperon Rouge.
sentences.english: Everyone called her Little Red Riding Hood.

sentences.french: Un jour, sa mère lui demanda de rendre visite à sa grand-mère malade.
sentences.english: One day, her mother asked her to visit her sick grandmother.

sentences.french: "Ne t'éloigne pas du chemin," lui conseilla sa mère.
sentences.english: "Don't wander off the path," her mother advised her.

sentences.french: Le Chaperon Rouge promit d'être sage et partit.
sentences.english: Red Riding Hood promised to be good and left.

sentences.french: En chemin, elle rencontra un loup rusé.
sentences.english: On the way, she met a cunning wolf.

sentences.french: Le loup lui demanda où elle allait si vite.
sentences.english: The wolf asked her where she was going so fast.

sentences.french: Elle répondit qu'elle allait chez sa grand-mère.
sentences.english: She answered that she was going to her grandmother's place.

sentences.french: Le loup décida d'y arriver avant elle.
sentences.english: The wolf decided to get there before her.

sentences.french: Le Chaperon Rouge s'arrêta pour cueillir des fleurs.
sentences.english: Red Riding Hood stopped to pick some flowers.

loup.mnemonic: Think 'loop' — the wolf runs in loops around you.

chemin.mnemonic: Think 'chimney' — a path up for smoke.
